event: Nala goes still under the hands and listens to the deep voice repeating its few sounds.
The sounds come slow and close, the same short run each time, with a breath between.
She tries to hold their shape, mouthing it over in her mind as the voice says it again.
Each time she reaches the end of it, the start has slipped; the middle blurs into the hum.
She tries again on the next repeat, and the next; the shape will not stay with her.
The deep voice stops; the heavier hand presses once more, then both hands lift.
The deep voices move off, a door thuds, and only the woman's humming stays above her.
